headline: SiTime customer session reports AFS, Symphony, and Solido use for MEMS oscillator SoC verification
fact: At Siemens User2User North America 2024, a customer-presented SiTime session described using Analog FastSPICE, Symphony, and Solido Design Environment to integrate analog and digital components and accelerate verification of high-precision MEMS-based oscillator SoCs.

sources.title: U2U24 Custom IC Verification Track Sessions
sources.summary: Siemens identifies the 2024 Custom IC Verification track as customer-presented sessions and lists SiTime verification acceleration with AFS, Symphony, and Solido for high-precision MEMS-based oscillator SoCs.

sources.title: Solido Simulation Suite resources
sources.summary: The current Siemens resource library identifies Vikram Vangapally of SiTime and repeats the Analog FastSPICE, Symphony, Solido Design Environment, analog/digital integration, and MEMS oscillator SoC verification scope.

sources.title: User2User North America 2024
sources.summary: The official event page dates the User2User North America 2024 main conference in Santa Clara to April 4, 2024.
